name: voicebridge.hud
licence_scope: LICENSE at the repo root applies to original Qubit material only. The collectors in this directory are adapted from the MIT-licensed upstream named above; the upstream copyright line is preserved in every file header and here.

changes: Home resolves through qubit_constants.get_qubit_home() (profiles are independent islands); no HERMES_HOME / legacy dot-home default.
Removed the `hermes --version` CLI shell-out; the build version is read from the checkout VERSION file and no subprocess is spawned.
Removed the second sqlite3 connection and the PRAGMA table_info schema walk over state.db; session/usage facts come from the QubitSessionStore authority (reload/list) and its analytics_usage rollup.
Service probes: gateway.pid + `systemctl --user is-active` + `pgrep llama-server` replaced by the <home>/state/gateway.heartbeat file and a loopback connect probe on the local-brain ports.

Feature rows for Sudo, Providers and Gateway dropped (their tabs are out of scope); Chat/Sessions/Model Analytics/Plugins/Cron rewired to Qubit dependencies; Skills and Gateway rows added from sources Qubit does expose.
API-key check list re-pointed at Qubit's provider registry env names plus the redacted credential-pool inventory (names only, never values).
Upstream's agent-schema baseline (VERIFIED_AGENT_VERSION / TESTED_SCHEMA_VERSIONS) removed: it described the upstream agent's state.db, not Qubit's.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of a dataclass tree.
Borrowed helpers from backend/collectors/config.py (_config_summary) so the health and model tabs agree on the configured model.
Reads jobs and execution history through voicebridge.cron_bridge (the live scheduler store) instead of parsing <home>/cron/jobs.json and opening notepad.db/executions.db itself.
Job shape follows cron_bridge.shape_job; monitor_script/monitor_url/continuity and the notepad preview are not published by that seam and are therefore absent rather than read behind its back.
Run preview honours the bridge's state/code/detail fields (an execution row's status column) instead of assuming a raw `status` key.
Summary counters (total/active/paused/has_errors) derived from the store's own effective_job_state.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of dataclass trees.
Runtime status is the PluginManager's own admit/error verdict from plugins.enabled/plugins.disabled, not an `enabled:` key read out of plugin.yaml.
Source set (bundled / user / entry-point / frontend overlay) comes from Qubit's plugin loader and dashboard discovery instead of a guessed parent-directory walk plus an untrusted project dir.
Dashboard half read from qubit_cli.web_server_dashboard discovery and frontend/qubit-app/plugins/*/manifest.json (the overlay the dashboard serves).

install_plugin / update_plugin (git clone/pull) and set_plugin_enabled / set_dashboard_plugin_hidden (manifest rewrites) are NOT ported: they are writers owned by `qubit plugins`, and a HUD tab must not be a second writer of plugin state.
Descriptions pass through voicebridge.hud.branding.rebrand_text at the served boundary.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of dataclass trees.
Skills come from tools.skills_tool._skill_catalog (Qubit's tier resolution, dedupe, platform/environment gates) instead of skills_dir.rglob('SKILL.md').
Frontmatter parsing delegated to the authority (the upstream hand-rolled key:value splitter is gone), so multi-line and quoted descriptions parse exactly as the agent sees them.
Category derived from the resolved relative_path rather than assuming <category>/<name>/SKILL.md.
is_custom from real provenance (profile dir not tracked by the bundled manifest) instead of a bulk-mtime heuristic; a new `source` field reports profile / bundled / external.
Upstream's 60s cache dropped: the catalog is already signature-cached by the skills tool.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of dataclass trees.

Catalog lookup goes through agent.models_dev.get_model_info (provider-id map, model_overrides, suffix/routing fallbacks, allow_network=False) instead of re-parsing models_dev_cache.json and scanning every provider.
Configured model/provider read through the same helper as collectors_health.
Capabilities expand the upstream five booleans with models.dev modalities, max input, cache-write cost and status.
Conversion table and effective_context_length rule (max(config, catalog)) preserved.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of a dataclass.

Reads voicebridge.qubit_session_store.analytics_usage (the authority's read-only rollup of the same sessions rows) instead of opening <home>/state.db with a second sqlite3 connection and a schema-spliced SELECT.
Per-session detail (upstream session_details) is not exposed by that rollup and is NOT fabricated; per-model totals, the daily series and last-use are kept.
Capability join onto usage rows removed; collectors_model_info owns capabilities so the two panels cannot disagree.
Window is bounded by the authority (1..365 days; days<=0 or None means 365) instead of an unbounded 'all' query.
Returned as a JSON-ready dict instead of dataclass trees.
Re-authored for Qubit: package docstring, the six ported modules, and one SKIP line per dropped HUD tab with the reason it has no truthful Qubit source.
Publishes the upstream pin, license and copyright constants.

Qubit-authored. Carry-over of the rebrand convention (voicebridge/qubit_plugins.rebrand_catalog_text) as pure text helpers: legacy-product substitutions, tab labels for the seven in-scope tabs, surface title.
Transcript mentions read through QubitSessionStore instead of a second sqlite3 opener on state.db
Outcome inference (exit_code/tool-blob regex, gateway.log prose scrape) removed; the approvals journal's real decision states are reported instead
The sudo rule is read from the LIVE voicebridge.safety.policy verdict rather than re-derived

tool_calls/reasoning/token_count reported null with a per-run reason (the authority publishes none)
rewind is reported as an available, confirmation-gated counterpart but never invoked
Reads the MemoryStore supersedes/history ledger instead of keyword-grepping MEMORY.md/USER.md and LIKE-scanning messages

Connection opened with PRAGMA query_only before any SELECT
The SQL aggregates are re-expressed over QubitSessionStore rows (no direct state.db access, no window-function JOIN)
Hour histogram computed in Python from started_at (the authority has no SQL seam)
tool_workflows returned null with a reason instead of an empty list
Added a daily token rollup from QubitSessionStore.analytics_usage
Qubit-authored: upstream has no verify collector (the tab shelled `hermes verify`)
Re-hashes voicebridge.checkpoints entries; an empty index is NO_CHECKPOINTS, never a pass
Qubit-authored: the upstream collector behind the 13-line stub router shelled `hermes auth`
Projects voicebridge.credentials.inventory + voicebridge.auth_status; no value, fragment or preview is read
Reads the voicebridge.projects registry instead of projects.db + a ~/projects directory scan
Git enrichment kept, but activity is bucketed from %ct rather than parsing a locale-dependent '3 days ago' string
Bounded: one git status per repo, a per-project timeout, and a projects inspection budget
Per-profile session totals read through QubitSessionStore on a profile-scoped cfg
systemctl service probe, outbound local-server probe and .env key-name scan removed (ProfileInfo.has_env answers the last one)
Qubit-authored helper: registry binding mirroring qubit_compat._profiles_module, and profile-scoped cfg construction

Reads voicebridge.active_memory.status + MemoryStore rows instead of parsing MEMORY.md/USER.md
The §-split, regex category tables and the 2200/1375 char budgets are not ported (they describe an upstream prompt limit)
PRAGMA query_only before any SELECT
Reads voicebridge.gateway_supervisor.status (a superset) and the RPC registry instead of gateway_state.json + a pid probe
run_action (detached CLI subprocess + log) removed: the HUD is a viewer
Per-platform rows come from the daemon's own platforms_map; absence is a typed reason
Qubit-authored: no chat WebSocket exists (QUBIT_WS_GATE_CODES refuses a second transport)
Serves the WS refusal plus a polled snapshot of voicebridge.events.journal (RUN_STARTED/STATE_SNAPSHOT tail)
Qubit-authored: per-model capability rows via agent.models_dev (the /api/model/info path)

upstream_api_reference.note: Response shapes were read from these upstream routers; no router code was copied and this package registers no route.

recorded_by: voicebridge/hud/PROVENANCE.json — updated 2026-11-06 when the twelve panels were restored; every `previous_claim` above is preserved verbatim so the measurement that overturned it stays checkable.

panels_restored._record: The previous revision of this file listed twelve tabs under `dropped_tabs` on claims that Qubit had no data (e.g. 'Qubit records no correction events', 'MemoryStore exposes no single read authority'). Each claim was re-measured against the worktree on 2026-11-06 and found false: the inputs were either already published by a Qubit module or reachable through the session authority. The list is kept here with its evidence so the claim can be re-checked, not re-asserted. Decision values: PORT (upstream logic over Qubit inputs), MAP (Qubit equivalent, adapted), GAP (genuinely absent; typed reason returned).

sudo_governance.previous_claim: Qubit keeps no structured sudo-approval ledger to read.
evidence: voicebridge/safety/policy.py DESTRUCTIVE_PATTERNS matches \bsudo\b and SafetyPolicy.check() returns require_confirm
voicebridge/approvals.py ApprovalJournal is a durable append-only JSONL state machine (in_progress/executing/complete/denied/aborted) at <state_dir>/approvals.jsonl
voicebridge/qubit_session_store.QubitSessionStore publishes role/content/timestamp rows for the mention scan
sudo_governance.not_ported: upstream's outcome inference from tool-result JSON and a gateway.log prose scrape (a guess, not a record)

replay.previous_claim: the session authority exposes no replay/rewind read model.
evidence: QubitSessionStore.list() returns id/title/source/model/started_at/last_active/message_count/tool_call_count/tokens
QubitSessionStore.messages(sid, limit, offset) returns {state, messages[{role,content,timestamp,meta}], total, limit, offset}
QubitSessionStore.rewind() exists as a confirmation-gated mutation (never called from the HUD)
replay.not_ported: per-step tool_calls/reasoning/token_count — null with an on-screen reason

evidence: voicebridge/memory/store.py memories.supersedes column + history table
MemoryStore.correct() writes action='corrected' (payload {superseded_by,to}) and action='correct' (payload {supersedes})
callers: voicebridge/memory/semantic.py:787, voicebridge/memory/journal.py:252, voicebridge/evaluation/runner.py:143
corrections.not_ported: upstream's memory-file keyword heuristic and its invented minor/major/critical severity

evidence: upstream mined nothing durable either: four SQL aggregates over sessions/messages at request time
every input is published by QubitSessionStore.list()/messages() (title, message_count, tool_call_count, started_at, first user message)
daily token rollup reuses QubitSessionStore.analytics_usage — the same function GET /api/analytics serves
patterns.not_ported: tool_workflows trigrams: the authority publishes no ordered tool-name sequence; returned null with a reason

verify.previous_claim: Qubit has no verify command and no verify artifact to read.
evidence: voicebridge/checkpoints.create() records a sha256 + line count of the action journal
voicebridge/checkpoints.verify(name) recomputes the digest and returns OK/TAMPERED/MISSING
list_all()/verify() are read-only; prune() is never called
verify.note: no upstream collector exists for this tab (upstream shelled `hermes verify`), so this file contains no upstream code

providers.previous_claim: HUD shelled `hermes auth`; the credential facts feed the health tab instead of a separate panel.
evidence: voicebridge/credentials.inventory() returns per-provider entries with id/label/auth_type/source/priority/last_status/request_count/has_refresh and an explicitly empty token_preview
voicebridge/auth_status.auth_status() returns key_ref kind (env/file/missing) + allowlisted per provider
providers.not_ported: the `hermes auth` shell-out and any network probe: /api/providers/validate is a recorded refusal (_NO_NETWORK_PROBE)

projects.previous_claim: Qubit's projects.db has no single-writer public read seam.
evidence: Qubit has no projects.db; voicebridge/projects.py is the canonical registry (schema qubit-projects/1)
list_projects(cfg) backs the CLI `qubit project`, the dashboard Projects page and GET /api/profiles/projects/tree
projects.not_ported: upstream's raw ~/projects directory scan (a folder is not a project)

profiles.previous_claim: a cross-profile aggregate would need a second home reader.
evidence: the profile registry (voicebridge/qubit_compat.py::_profiles_module binding) is a deliberately shared list surface
QubitSessionStore is constructed from a cfg, so a profile-scoped cfg reads THAT island's totals through the same authority — no second opener
profiles.not_ported: systemctl per profile, an outbound local-server probe, and an .env KEY/TOKEN/SECRET substring scan

memory.previous_claim: Memory providers are plugin-owned and expose no single read authority.
evidence: voicebridge/active_memory.status(cfg) is one authority (state/enabled/min_score/max_items/store_state/store_path/memories/estop) and GET /api/memory serves it
voicebridge/memory/store.py owns tiers/scope/kind/confidence/sensitivity/tombstoned/staged rows
memory.not_ported: MEMORY.md/USER.md §-splitting, the regex category tables, and the upstream 2200/1375 char budgets (a prompt limit Qubit does not enforce)

gateway.previous_claim: Qubit gateway control is an operator/action surface, not a read-only collector.
evidence: voicebridge/gateway_supervisor.status(cfg) is a superset of upstream's gateway_state.json read: unit, active/sub state, pid, port probe, n_restarts, health, daemon snapshot, control socket
daemon.platforms_map carries per-platform state
voicebridge/gateway/rpc.py default_registry().names() is the RPC surface GET /api/gateway/rpc serves
gateway.not_ported: upstream's run_action (detached subprocess of the CLI); the HUD is a viewer

live_chat.previous_claim: Out of scope by owner decision; needs a websocket this package does not own.
evidence: voicebridge/webui.py QUBIT_WS_GATE_CODES refuses /api/ws, /api/pub, /api/audio/speak-stream and /api/plugins/kanban/events with WS_SINGLE_PATH
voicebridge/events/journal.py EventJournal over <state_dir>/typed-events.jsonl is the durable single event path (redacted at write); it carries RUN_STARTED/RUN_FINISHED/RUN_CANCELLED/STATE_SNAPSHOT
live_chat.gap: no chat WebSocket; the panel is a polled snapshot and says so on screen

live_model_capabilities.previous_claim: Collapsed into collectors_model_info, which reads the real models.dev catalog Qubit ships.
evidence: agent.models_dev.get_model_capabilities(provider, model) is the same call GET /api/model/info makes (_CAPABILITY_FIELDS)
voicebridge/chat_transport.resolve_route/resolve_model give the model a turn actually uses
qubit_cli.inventory.build_model_options_payload(refresh=False) gives the ids the dashboard picker offers
voicebridge/providers/dead_models records recent REAL call failures
live_model_capabilities.gap: no live probe endpoint; /api/providers/validate is a recorded refusal, so rows say 'catalog', never 'pinged'
